messages.content:
Generate 1-4 actionable dashboard insights as JSON.
Return ONLY JSON, no markdown.
Use schema keys exactly: type_label,title,description,timestamp,action_label,action_url,tone.
Allowed tones: default, primary, indigo, emerald.
Allowed action_url values only: /tasks/?quick=overdue, /tasks/?quick=due_week, /tasks/?status=done, /tasks/?quick=high_priority.

Metrics:
{"overdue_count": 1, "due_soon_count": 0, "due_this_week_count": 2, "done_recently_count": 2, "high_no_due_count": 0}

    "tone": "emerald"
  }
]
